{{Quote|Choowahai, stranger. That's Evocii native speak for "hello."|Var'soonta|<ref name="Trophy" />}}
'''Var'soonta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who sold salvage to [[Evocii]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He ran his business, ''Var'soonta's Many Treasures'', out of the settlement of [[Voam]] near [[Jiguuna]], assisted by an Evocii native, [[Imot]]. After Imot spoke up to a visitor about a [[Horell|hunter]] who was slaughtering his people, that Imperial-aligned individual was further informed of the situation by Var'soonta, and agreed to help.
